mapper.sql: f.perf_id, f.user_id, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm, f.period_id, p.period_nm, f.goal, f.kpi, f.unit, f.target_val, f.actual_val, f.ach_rate, f.weight, f.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_perf (user_id, period_id, goal, kpi, unit, target_val, actual_val, ach_rate, weight) VALUES (#{userId}, #{periodId}, #{goal}, #{kpi}, #{unit}, #{targetVal}, #{actualVal}, #{achRate}, COALESCE(#{weight}, 100))
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_perf SET goal = #{goal}, kpi = #{kpi}, unit = #{unit}, target_val = #{targetVal}, actual_val = #{actualVal}, ach_rate = #{achRate}, weight = COALESCE(#{weight}, weight) WHERE perf_id = #{perfId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_perf f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = f.period_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE f.perf_id = #{perfId}

SELECT FROM gw_perf f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = f.period_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.period_id = #{periodId} ORDER BY f.weight DESC, f.perf_id

SELECT FROM gw_perf f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = f.period_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND f.period_id = #{periodId} ORDER BY u.name, f.perf_id

SELECT FROM gw_perf f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = f.period_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE f.period_id = #{periodId} ORDER BY u.dept_id, u.name, f.perf_id
